about: Contributors the maintainers know, by GitHub login. A full audit of a listing on proven models, made on one of their runs after its last annotation and followed by a sample on proven models, stands in for the maintainer's check that a run on an unproven model needs (kit/CHECKING.md). The audit row carries their login as `by`. Logins are compared without regard to case. A game passed this way proves no model.

known.Nico-van-der-Zijden: known to the maintainers, declared on 29 October 2026
